questions.question:
**Directions: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate word.**

When the train ______ in the middle of a forest, passengers were in a panic.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'stopped'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the past simple tense, therefore the past form of the verb should be used in the blank.
 
• The past simple tense is used to talk about a completed action (passengers were in a panic) in a time before now (When the train...).
 
• The simple past tense of regular verbs is marked by the ending -d or -ed (here, stopped).

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

**Complete Sentence:** *When the train stopped in the middle of a forest, passengers were in a panic*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The option 'are stopped' is used to make a present passive form. We use **to be (is, am, are)** + past participle of the verb.
 
• The option 'were stopping' is the past continuous form of the verb.
 
• The option 'stop' is the base form of the verb.

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select No substitution.**

__The peoples__ standing on the street are shouting in anger.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'The people'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the underlined segment, the **plural form of the noun 'peoples'** is **incorrect**.
 
• The **plural form 'peoples'** is only **used when** it is necessary **to distinguish between** **ethnic groups within the same geographical or cultural context**.
 
 
• **Example:** *The Indian and Pakistani **peoples** have long been at war*.
 
 
 
• The **plural form 'people'** should be used **in place of 'peoples'**.
 
• When we refer **to the people of a single ethnic group or nationality**, always use the word '**people**'.

 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Correct Sentence:** ***The people** standing on the street are shouting in anger*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• *The **first and fourth options** are **incorrect** as the **noun 'person'** is a **singular noun** and the **verb 'are'** used in the sentence is in the **plural form** and we know that **subjects and verbs must agree with one another in number** (singular or plural).*

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

I climbed the steep mountain quite easily.

options.text: The steep mountain was climbed quite easily by me.
I was able to climb the steep mountain quite easily.
The steep mountain is climbed quite easily by me.
The steep mountain was being climbed quite easily by me.

questions.solution:

• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the active voice and 'I' is the subject and 'the steep mountain' is the object.
 
• When we convert this sentence into passive voice, the subject **'I'** of the active voice becomes the object 'me', the object 'the steep **mountain**' **becomes** the **subject**.
 
• The passive format "'was + V3 (climbed)" should be used.
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the past simple tense.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1*.*

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate meaning of the following idiom.**

Actions speak louder than words

options.text: All your actions help you in understanding what to do
Intentions can be judged by people’s actions
Speaking loudly is the best way to let others know what you want
Whatever you speak is less important than what you write

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**Intentions can be judged by people’s actions**.**'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Given Idiom: ***Actions speak louder than words*** means **to emphasize that what you do is more important and shows your intentions and feelings more clearly than what you say**.

 
 
• *Example: Politicians are all the same, all talk but no work; do they realize that **actions speak louder than words**?*
 
 
 
• From the given options, the second option is the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points__**

__
 
• We may think from the phrase "Actions speak louder than words" that it is all about speaking is less important than you write, but the correct answer is option 2. So be careful while dealing with such questions.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• *This statement is a very old proverb and is found in many languages and in various forms. It was first recorded in English in this exact way In 1736, in a piece of writing with the title the Melancholy State of Province.*

options.text: Rakshit said that he is getting bored of watching TV.

questions.solution:

• The given sentence is a direct speech.
 
• The basic rules for changing or converting direct speech into indirect speech:​

• The present simple tense format 'Subject + V1 (am) + Object' will be changed into the past simple tense format 'Subject + V2 (was) + Object'.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

• The following table will enable us to know how tense changes into Indirect speech:-
